svg.text: Redesign the pi web UI: real pages for Projects / MCP / Usage, model switcher, clean status bar, per-message usage, stop buttons everywhere.

• Left rail with 6 pages — session list stays inside Chat.
• Status bar: context bar + cost + model chip, no raw ANSI (stripped at the extension boundary).
Type check passes. Next: design tokens CSS, then the rail + router shell.
